name: Takayama
source:
A manly guy.

[SPOILER]Though Takayama is a biology teacher, he wears a tracksuit which makes him look more like a P.E. teacher. Apparently, he enjoys baking. Takayama is a pervert that doesn't really hesitate in trying to "cross the student-teacher boundaries" with Mofuko.[/SPOILER]
